ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across the central and lateral lobes; high-density black pixel saturation centered at the median notch and extending along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant yellowish-brown tinting (diatom accumulation) localized in the lower quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped vertex approximately 40-45 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; most pronounced jaggedness observed at the lateral tips and the immediate margins of the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sloping concave curve from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters and raised geometric textures localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment; scattered dark micro-spots in the lower-left white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, short horizontal dark linear disruptions on the mid-right lobe; two faint diagonal linear marks on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark spotting on the lower interior of the left lobe; distal tips show jagged irregularity from previous encrustations.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced orange-brown discoloration across the lower ventral surface, contrasting sharply with the primary white pigmentation.
